items.title: The foundation: Why Temporal for a data pipeline?
items.feed_description: How to justify Temporal for a regulated data pipeline: the requirements, the naive approach, and why Durable Execution wins on resilience and auditability.
items.summary: Temporal is highlighted as the orchestration layer for a PII-compliant data pipeline processing customer complaints. The pipeline handles CSV ingestion, PII redaction, classification, semantic search, and compliance requirements without exposing raw data. Key features include durable execution, retries, and state persistence to ensure data resilience and auditability.
features: Durable Execution for workflow resumption after failures
Retry mechanisms with progress tracking for ingestion
State persistence via Redis/Postgres for consistency
Integration with vector databases for semantic search
items.why_it_matters: Temporal's capabilities ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and operational resilience, critical for enterprises handling sensitive customer information in complex data pipelines.

items.title: Astro Observe data quality now in Preview
items.feed_description: Preview This feature is in Preview . Astro Observe data quality for Snowflake and Databricks is now available in Preview. Data quality helps you monitor tables and columns for data quality issues including row volume changes, schema changes, and null columns, alerting on issues and displaying upstream and downstream table-level lineage to help keep your data accurate and complete. See data quality for setup and more information. Additional improvements Astro Observe SLAs now support flexible cron-based schedules to capture complex business logic and allow more control over SLA sensitivity.
items.summary: Astronomer released Astro Observe data quality in preview, enhancing monitoring capabilities. Key updates include Otto integration for code reviews, Sub-Second Pipelines for high-throughput workflows, and improved Deployment analytics. The Astro CLI 1.42.1, Runtime 3.3-2, and Remote Execution Agent 1.8.1 are now available.
features: Astro Observe data quality preview for monitoring
Otto code review integration for pull requests and merge requests
Sub-Second Pipelines for Airflow 3.2+ deployments with event-driven scheduling
Enhanced Deployment analytics with Kubernetes executor coverage
DAG-level access control for role-based permissions
IP access list protection to prevent accidental lockout
Testing against existing deployments in Astro IDE
Environment Manager migration for connections and variables
items.why_it_matters: These updates improve workflow reliability, security, and collaboration, enabling teams to monitor pipelines more effectively, automate code reviews, and manage resources with finer granularity.
